name: Steel Taipan
description: The most thrilling roller coaster in Australia — Steel Taipan is a spectacular launched coaster that blasts riders from 0 to 105 km/h in just 2.5 seconds and then delivers an extraordinary layout of inversions, high-speed turns and powerful forces through a dramatic track that snakes around the Dreamworld precinct. Named after Australia's deadliest snake, Steel Taipan delivers one of the most intense and exciting coaster experiences in the Southern Hemisphere. Min 130cm.

name: Tower of Terror II
description: One of the most iconic and extreme thrill rides in Australia — Tower of Terror II is a launched reverse freefall coaster that catapults riders backwards at 160 km/h up a 115-metre vertical tower before releasing them in a terrifying freefall descent. One of the tallest and fastest rides in the Southern Hemisphere and a Dreamworld institution. Min 130cm.

name: Giant Drop
description: One of the tallest free-fall drop towers in the world — Giant Drop raises riders 120 metres above the Gold Coast and then releases them in a breathtaking free fall at over 130 km/h. The panoramic views from the summit over the Gold Coast hinterland and coastline are extraordinary. A true Australian theme park icon. Min 130cm.

name: The Claw
description: Australia's largest pendulum ride — The Claw is a massive double-sided swinging pendulum that rotates riders completely over the top while swinging at extreme heights, delivering breathtaking Gold Coast views and one of the most intense pendulum ride experiences in Australia. Min 130cm.

name: Mick Doohan's Motocoaster
description: A unique motorcycle-position coaster where riders sit astride motorcycle-style vehicles and experience high-speed twists and turns — Mick Doohan's Motocoaster delivers a distinctive riding experience unlike any other coaster in Australia. Min 120cm.

name: Gold Rush
description: A classic mine train roller coaster winding through an elaborately themed Australian gold rush environment — Gold Rush delivers accessible family thrills through an exciting layout and is one of the most popular family coasters at Dreamworld. Min 110cm.

name: Tiger Island
description: One of Australia's most beloved wildlife experiences — Tiger Island at Dreamworld is home to Bengal and Sumatran tigers in a beautiful naturalistic habitat with daily tiger presentations where keepers interact with the resident tigers. One of the most extraordinary and intimate wildlife encounters available at any theme park in Australia. Suitable for all ages.

name: Pandamonium
description: A wildly spinning family coaster delivering fun rotational forces and exciting hills — Pandamonium is one of the most popular and rerideable family attractions at Dreamworld and a perfect bridge between family and thrill rides. Min 110cm.

name: WhiteWater World
description: Dreamworld's spectacular water park featuring Australia's most diverse and exciting collection of water slides, wave pools, a lazy river and toddler water play zones. WhiteWater World is the most complete and entertaining water park on the Gold Coast and one of the best in Australia. Separate admission applies. Min varies by slide.

name: FlowRider
description: An exhilarating surf simulation attraction at WhiteWater World — FlowRider generates a continuous artificial wave that allows guests to bodyboard or stand-up surf in a safe and controlled environment. The most popular and exciting surf attraction at any theme park in Australia. Min 106cm.

name: Shrek's Swamp
description: A delightful family dark ride adventure through the world of Shrek and DreamWorks animation — featuring beloved characters including Shrek, Donkey and Fiona in an entertaining and cheerful attraction that is one of the most popular family experiences at Dreamworld. Suitable for all ages.

name: Wiggles World
description: A dedicated young children's zone themed to Australia's most beloved children's entertainment brand The Wiggles — featuring gentle rides, live shows and interactive experiences perfectly scaled for toddlers and young children. The most beloved family attraction for young children at any Gold Coast theme park. Suitable for all ages.

name: Dreamworld Corroboree
description: A unique and culturally significant Australian wildlife and Indigenous culture experience at Dreamworld — Corroboree showcases Australian native animals including koalas, wombats, kangaroos and echidnas alongside authentic presentations of Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander culture and art. One of the most meaningful and educational experiences at any Australian theme park. Suitable for all ages.
